test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

PROACTIVE
solution:
The correct answer is '**Enthusiastic**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Proactive**' is '**Enthusiastic**'.
 
• **Proactive**: controlling a situation by making things happen rather than waiting for things to happen and then reacting to them. (घटनाओं की सक्रियता को स्‍वयं आरंभ करने वाला, न कि प्रतिक्रिया हेतु उनके स्‍वयं घटित होने तक प्रतीक्षारत; अग्रसक्रिय, निश्‍चयपूर्वक सक्रिय)
 
 
• *Example: The city is taking a **proactive** approach to fighting crime by hiring more police officers.*
 
 
 
• **Enthusiastic**: full of excitement and interest in something. [(किसी वस्‍तु या कार्य के विषय में) उत्‍साहपूर्ण; उत्तेजना और रुचि से पूर्ण]
 
 
• *Example: They were **enthusiastic** supporters of the president.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Enthusiastic.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Reactive**: showing a reaction or response. (प्रतिक्रिया या अनुक्रिया प्रकट करने वाला; प्रतिक्रियाकारी, अनुक्रियाकारी)
 
• **Short**-**sighted**: able to see things clearly only when they are very close to you. (केवल निकट की वस्‍तुओं को देखने में समर्थ; निकटदर्शी)
 
• **Heedless**: showing a reckless lack of care or attention. ( देखभाल या ध्यान की लापरवाह कमी दिखा रहा है )
